capabilities: wrap selected text in paired symbols
auto-complete closing single and double quotes
extras: README is bilingual (English/Chinese) and mostly a feature and TODO list; an ignore-list setting is still unfinished.
problem: Obsidian's bracket auto-pairing does not cover full-width Chinese punctuation, so these symbols must be typed and closed manually.
summary: Typing helper that auto-completes and pairs Chinese punctuation such as 《》, 【】, （）, quotes, and corner brackets.
